rows.base_narrative: Gaurav Malhotra, Gurgaon. A lot happened this month. On 5 August 2024 a small electrical fire damaged a wall and a cabinet near the kitchen. Separately, on 12 August someone broke my back window and took jewellery worth ₹80,000 (police report filed). And on top of that I noticed the bathroom cabinet has some water staining I can't explain the age of. Fire cleanup and cabinet repair is ₹20,000, the water-stained cabinet replacement is ₹18,000, and I mentioned the jewellery above.
